標題： 🎉親愛的準畢業生，邀請您參加113學年度畢業典禮，迎接屬於您的榮耀時刻！
日期： Thu, 1 May 2025 17:57:39 +0800
附檔： 2025請柬_正面.jpg (2 MB)   2025請柬_背面.jpg (2 MB)   
親愛的畢業生您好：
驪歌輕唱，盛夏將至，這一天是屬於您們的榮耀時刻！
本校113學年度畢業典禮將於下列時間舉行，誠摯邀請您親自參加，穿上學位袍，來到活動會場，讓我們一起見證您邁向人生下一段旅程！
📅 **時間｜114年5月24日（星期六）下午16:00整
📍 **地點｜本校體育館
🎓 畢業生報名請至：
https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=24843
（請一定要報名，我們才能幫您安排座位及抽獎劵～期待一下神秘禮物吧!!!）

🕔 報名截止日期：5月5日下午17點整，為利座位安排，敬請盡早報名，感謝您的配合！期待在典禮現場，見到您充滿自信與喜悅的身影，
讓我們一同迎接屬於東華畢業生的榮耀時刻，為自己喝采、向未來啟程！
這不只是一場儀式，
是我們給您的祝福、您給自己的一個句點，
從這裡起飛，去更遠的地方！
讓我們5月24日，現場見👋
青春不散場，東華驕傲的您，準備好閃亮登場了嗎？
With all our love and best wishes,
🧡 學生事務處 敬邀

Subject: Congratulations, Graduates! You're Invited to the 2025 NDHU Commencement Ceremony!
Dear Graduating Students,
The 2025 Commencement Ceremony of NDHU is just around the corner, and we sincerely invite you to be part of it in person. Put on your gown, walk into the venue, and let us celebrate this incredible milestone together as you step into your next chapter.
📅 Date｜ Saturday, May 24, 2025, at 4:00 PM
📍 Venue｜ NDHU Gymnasium
🎓 Graduates, please register here:
👉 https://sys.ndhu.edu.tw/SA/XSL_ApplyRWD/ActAnnounce.aspx?ActID=24843
(Yes, registration is a must—so we can reserve your seat and prepare your lucky draw ticket 🎁... get ready for a surprise gift!)
🕔 Registration Deadline: 5:00 PM, May 5
To help us arrange seating properly, please register early. Thank you for your cooperation!
We can’t wait to see your confident and joyful smiles on that day.
Let’s come together to celebrate the glory of being an NDHU graduate—cheer for yourself, and step boldly into your future!
This isn’t just a ceremony—
It’s our blessing to you, and a powerful full stop to this chapter you’ve written.
From here, you’ll soar even farther.
📍 Let’s meet on May 24—see you there!
Youth never fades,NDHU’s brightest stars—are you ready to shine?
With all our love and best wishes,
🧡 Office of Student Affairs
